fullPassage: It is common to read that farm data belongs to the farmer. It is sometimes even stated in contracts. However, 'ownership' is a legal assertion and data ownership is not addressed by legislation except for copyright for datasets as intellectual products. This is partly due to the peculiar nature of data compared to other goods that can be owned. In legal terms, it is non-rivalrous: the same data can be in different places and be owned by different people because, when data is copied or migrated to other platforms, it remains the same. In addition, there is a difference between data collected in a structured dataset, which can be considered as an intellectual product by law, and raw data as individual, unstructured bits before they are collected and made sense of. These raw data are similar to facts, for which no copyright and no ownership is legally applicable.

✅ ② (A) 조건 - (B) 관점: (A) the terms of the deal=거래 '조건', (B) in legal terms=법적 '관점'에서 ← 정답
❌ ③ (A) 관점 - (B) 조건: 둘 다 반대
❌ ④ (A) 관점 - (B) 관점: (A) terms of the deal은 '조건'
det.tip: the terms of a deal=거래 조건. in ~ terms=~의 관점/측면에서. 문맥으로 의미 구별.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the exclusive legal right to reproduce, publish, or sell an original literary or artistic work"

det.korean: 원작 문학·예술 작품을 복제·출판·판매할 독점적 법적 권리
det.analysis:
❌ ① patent(특허): 발명품에 대한 권리, 저작물이 아님
❌ ② trademark(상표): 브랜드 식별 표지에 대한 권리
✅ ③ copyright(저작권): 원작물 복제·출판·판매의 독점권=저작권 정의 ← 정답
❌ ④ royalty(로열티): 저작권 사용에 지불하는 대가
det.tip: copyright=저작권. 원저작물을 복제·출판·판매할 독점적 권리.

questions.passage: In legal terms, it is non-rivalrous: the same data can be in different places and be owned by different people because, when data is copied or migrated to other platforms, it __________ (remain) the same.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: remain → remains: 주어 it(단수)에 맞춘 3인칭 단수 현재형
det.analysis: 주어가 it(=the same data, 단수) → 현재시제 동사에 -s를 붙여 remains. 'it remains the same'=그것은 동일하게 유지된다
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어 + 현재시제 → 동사원형 + s. remain → remains.

questions.passage: In addition, there is a difference between data collected in a structured dataset, which can be __________ (consider) as an intellectual product by law, and raw data as individual, unstructured bits before they are collected and made sense of.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로)

det.korean: consider → considered: 조동사 can + be 다음의 수동태(be + p.p.)
det.analysis: 'can be __________ as~' 구조. 주어(데이터셋)가 지적 재산물로 '간주되는' 대상이므로 수동태 필요. can be + considered(과거분사). consider → considered
det.tip: can be + 과거분사(p.p.) = 수동태. consider(간주하다) → considered(간주되는).

questions.passage: It is common to read that farm data belongs to the farmer. It is sometimes even stated in contracts. However, 'ownership' is a legal assertion and data ownership is not addressed by legislation except for copyright for datasets as intellectual products. This is partly due to the peculiar nature of data compared to other goods that can be owned. In legal terms, it is non-rivalrous: the same data can be in different places and be owned by different people because, when data is __________ to other platforms, it remains the same. In addition, there is a difference between data collected in a structured dataset, which can be considered as an intellectual product by law, and raw data as individual, unstructured bits before they are collected and made sense of. These raw data are similar to facts, for which no copyright and no ownership is legally applicable.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 데이터가 다른 플랫폼으로 ______되어도 그대로 유지된다
det.analysis:
❌ ① priced or taxed(가격이 매겨지거나 과세되는): 플랫폼 이동 맥락과 무관
❌ ② hidden or destroyed(숨겨지거나 파괴되는): 파괴되면 '동일하게 유지'와 모순
❌ ③ signed or dated(서명되거나 날짜가 적히는): 데이터 이동이 아님
✅ ④ copied or migrated(복사되거나 이전되는): 복사·이전되어도 동일하게 유지=비경합성 ← 정답
det.tip: copied or migrated to other platforms=복사·이전. 그래도 remains the same이 비경합성의 근거.

det.korean: raw data는 수집되고 ______되기 전의 개별적·비구조적 조각이다
det.analysis:
❌ ① given away freely(무료로 배포되기): 문맥에 근거 없음
❌ ② sold as products(생산물로 판매되기): raw data는 소유·판매 대상이 아님
✅ ③ made sense of(이해·해석되기): 수집되어 의미가 부여되기 전의 원자료 ← 정답
❌ ④ protected by copyright(저작권으로 보호되기): raw data는 저작권 적용 안 됨
det.tip: make sense of=이해하다/의미를 파악하다. raw data=수집·해석 전의 개별 조각.
